name: Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood Care and Education
notes: No Mathematics requirement stated. Police clearance certificate recommended to enrol.

name: Bachelor of Education in Foundation Phase Teaching (Grade R to Grade 3)
notes: No Mathematics requirement stated. Police clearance certificate recommended to enrol. Foundation Phase modules in English, Afrikaans and an Indigenous African language are offered in language-specific classes.

name: Bachelor of Education in Intermediate Phase Teaching (Grades 4 to 6)
notes: No Mathematics requirement stated. Police clearance certificate recommended to enrol.

name: Bachelor of Education in Senior Phase and Further Education and Training Teaching (Grades 7 to 12)
notes: No Mathematics requirement stated. Police clearance certificate recommended to enrol. Elective modules in Physical Sciences or Life Sciences additionally require Physical Sciences or Life Sciences at level 5 (60%) and Mathematics at level 5 (60%); not encoded as programme requirements because they only apply to those electives.

name: Higher Certificate in Sports Sciences
notes: Selection programme: applicants considered by Student Administration on academic requirements, then by sports codes in consultation with TuksSport; preference to applicants nominated by an official UP sports club. Diploma endorsement applicants may be considered. No Mathematics requirement stated. Completing it with a cumulative weighted average of at least 70% (excluding JRC 150 Sports Practical) can lead to the BEd Senior Phase and FET (Human Movement Studies and Sports Management).

name: Higher Certificate in Sports Sciences (Online)
notes: Selection programme: applicants considered by Student Administration on academic requirements, then by sports codes in consultation with TuksSport; preference to applicants nominated by an official UP sports club. Diploma endorsement applicants may be considered. No Mathematics requirement stated. Online programme: students need at least part-time access to schools, sports clubs and/or accredited training facilities relevant to their specialisation. Completing it with a cumulative weighted average of at least 70% (excluding JRC 180 Sports Practical) can lead to the BEd Senior Phase and FET (Human Movement Studies and Sports Management).
